newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady to firmer.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady to firmer.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to firmer on Thursday, traders said.
Spot gasoline prices were little changed but the spot/paper market contango widened, getting a boost from Wednesday's NYMEX unleaded gains and short-covering against possible Nigerian demand.
Gas oil was slightly stronger in line with moderate futures gains. A small heating oil barge parcel traded at around July IPE flat fob ARA for July delivery.
Prompt high sulphur fuel oil barges traded steady at $83 a tonne fob ARA in a quiet market while July barges were done at $83.75.
High sulphur cargoes were offered a little higher, with cracked material on offer at $81/$81.50 while buying interest was said to be coming in at around the $79 a tonne.
